themes.title: Electoral Volatility and Internal Friction Facing Right-Wing Parties
themes.blurb: Right-wing parties across several nations are grappling with internal divisions, electoral challenges, and debates over their political positioning. This includes intense campaigning for upcoming elections, internal dissent regarding party figures or policy directions, and ongoing discussions about party legitimacy within broader political landscapes.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Vice President Vance campaigns extensively for midterms but faces GOP resistance; candidates diverge from 'America First' on local issues or immigration; some voters express strong disillusionment with Trump and the party.

countries.name: 🇳🇴 Fremskrittspartiet
countries.note: Focus on mayoral candidates and local political debates weighing experience against new strategies, indicating active electoral engagement and party positioning.

countries.name: 🇸🇪 Sverigedemokraterna
countries.note: An op-ed discusses the party's potential exclusion from government, highlighting ongoing challenges to its political legitimacy and inclusion.

themes.title: Trump's 'America First' Global Repercussions
themes.blurb: The 'America First' foreign policy doctrine continues to shape global interactions, driving protectionist threats against international partners and prompting observations about a shifting global order. This approach includes transactional diplomacy, such as major arms sales and direct engagement on trade or security issues, while inspiring policy comparisons in other countries.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: The administration pursues protectionist policies, threatening tariffs against EU/Canada; advances major arms deals to Saudi Arabia; engages in high-level summits with China on trade/fentanyl; and shapes global health strategy under 'America First' principles.

countries.name: Australia (via 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump ref)
countries.note: Australia's Labor government's plans for visa overstayer detention centers are directly compared to Donald Trump's immigration crackdown, showcasing policy inspiration or parallel development.

themes.title: Challenges to Established Institutions and Norms
themes.blurb: Right-wing narratives and policies are actively challenging a range of established institutions and societal norms. This includes governmental actions questioning the autonomy of cultural and scientific bodies, scrutinizing educational practices regarding gender, and re-evaluating the legitimacy of political parties based on historical ideology.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: The administration investigates schools over gender transition, weakens environmental protections, threatens cultural institutions like the Kennedy Center, faces legal challenges over NIH grant censorship, and sees its vaccine policies criticized.

countries.name: 🇸🇪 Sverigedemokraterna
countries.note: An op-ed argues for excluding the Left Party from government due to its history, drawing parallels with the debate over SD's own political legitimacy within established norms.

themes.title: Immigration Policy and Enforcement Debates
themes.blurb: Debates surrounding immigration policy are intensifying, with a focus on stringent enforcement measures and challenges to existing rules. This includes the implementation of stricter conditions for immigrants seeking benefits, the use of advanced technology for targeting, and discussions around detention policies that draw comparisons across borders.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: The 'public charge' rule goes into effect; AI is used to target immigrants; enforcement actions are announced for visa fraud; funding cuts impact refugee services; and a Republican challenges Trump's approach as alienating to Hispanic voters.

countries.name: Australia (via 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump ref)
countries.note: Australia's plans to reopen detention centers for visa overstayers are explicitly likened to Donald Trump's immigration crackdown, indicating a shared policy direction or rhetorical frame.

themes.title: Enduring Influence of Populist Personalities
themes.blurb: Populist personalities continue to exert significant influence over national political discourse and party direction. This manifests in the high visibility of leading figures during electoral campaigns, their impact on policy discussions, and the reactions, both supportive and critical, they elicit from within their own parties and the wider public.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Donald Trump's administration actions, campaign trail activities, and controversial statements dominate coverage; Vice President JD Vance is highly active in campaigning and making public statements, drawing both support and criticism.
